snippet.title: It's the Insides That Count - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Rise and shine, doctors. You and your friends are alien surgeons who've never seen a human before. After 37 minutes of training, you're tasked with a Routine Maintenance Procedure on a human whose DNA got mutated by the tractor beam. Good luck.

1-4 player co-op surgery comedy. Extract the right organs, brew the right compounds, contain the mutations, and DO NOT let the human be reborn aboard the ship.

Wishlist Now On Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5175780/Its_the_Insides_That_Count?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=longform&utm_campaign=trailer

For fans of Surgeon Simulator, Lethal Company, R.E.P.O. and Surgeon Simulator. If Surgeon Simulator's organs crawled off the table and fought back, this is roughly what you'd get.
